name: Simply Organic Dried Mediterranean Oregano Leaves
whyItWorks: Fragrant dried leaves rich in carvacrol and thymol with mild carminative benefits. Unlike garlic and onion powder, dried oregano provides authentic Italian flavor without FODMAP fermentation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Rub between your fingertips to crush into fine powder and sprinkle over plain chicken, olive oil pasta, or zucchini.
